title: From Decisions to Leadership
summary: AI as Business OS — Moving from operator to system builder through one recurring decision.

sections.heading: Orientation — Starting the Journey
sections.subtitle: Starting the Journey
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **What Will You Understand?** AI is not just a tool to speed up tasks — it can be part of a **Business OS** that transitions you from an executor to a system builder.
- **Why Now?** The **Business** path is not just general management — it's about how to run your business with AI as an operating system: decisions, time, customers, and repetition.
- **What After the Lesson?** You will write down 3 recurring decisions or problems you face — and choose one where AI can assist you as a thinking partner or as a system.

sections.heading: Tension — A Familiar Situation
sections.subtitle: A Familiar Situation
sections.contentMarkdown:
- If every small decision comes your way — responding to WhatsApp, approving prices, following up with suppliers — then you are not a leader; you are the bottleneck.
- Many use AI to write emails faster. This is helpful — but it's only 10% of the value. The remaining 90% comes when AI helps you think through decisions, see patterns, and build a system that works without you.
- The question is not 'Am I smart enough?' — the question is: 'What recurs every week and consumes my time, and how can AI alleviate it so I can build a system?'

sections.heading: Core Idea — AI: Tool — System — Thinking Partner
sections.subtitle: AI: Tool — System — Thinking Partner
sections.contentMarkdown:
- **Level 1 — Tool:** You write a **Prompt** and get a faster response (message, summary, idea). This is an **Operator** working at a higher speed.
- **Level 2 — System:** You use AI to document a recurring decision, prioritize tasks, or reduce repetitive administrative work each week.
- **Level 3 — Thinking Partner:** You present a decision to AI, which asks questions and clarifies alternatives — and you decide. This frees up your time for building rather than firefighting.
- **The Real Shift:** From 'I work' to 'I design what works.' AI does not replace you — it helps you build your **Business OS** step by step.

sections.heading: Glossary — Two Terms to Start
sections.subtitle: Two Terms to Start
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Term | Meaning | Example |
|---------|--------|------|
| **Operator** | The worker who drives the work with their energy — every decision and follow-up goes through them | Responds to every message, approves every request, and has no time to think about expansion |
| **Business OS** | A set of habits, decisions, and AI assistance that makes work run smoothly — not based on your daily mood | Weekly priority list + response templates + protected time for thinking |

sections.heading: Comparison — Operator Day vs System Builder Day
sections.subtitle: Operator Day vs System Builder Day
sections.contentMarkdown:
| Operator Day | System Builder Day |
|--------------|---------------|
| You open WhatsApp first, respond for two hours, put out fires, and go to sleep feeling like you 'worked' — but no strategic decision was made | A protected hour for thinking and numbers, AI helps you prioritize, then you deal with messages — you choose when, not the messages |

sections.heading: Mission — 3 Recurring Decisions — and One for AI
sections.subtitle: 3 Recurring Decisions — and One for AI
sections.contentMarkdown:
**Introduction:** A practical mission — not a theoretical analysis. Write down 3 recurring decisions or problems you face in your work each week, and choose one where AI can assist you as a thinking partner or as a system. A complete solution is not required — awareness and a clear choice are needed.

**Submission:** Recurring Decision #1 · #2 · #3 · What you chose for AI (only one) — and why it is the best choice among the three.

rows: The three decisions or problems from your reality — not general examples.
One selected decision and a reason related to your work.
